title: Bot C – Glitch Sky Bot (Psychedelic Satellite Scanner)
style: v4 Frenchcore, Dr. Peacock style, 228 BPM, instrumental-only glitch sky babble bot as backup singer, no normal human vocals for the bot. Glitchy chopped flute-like synths, airy high leads, granular delays, chopped textures, and weird melodic fragments as its voice, like a malfunctioning satellite radio scanning alien skies and parallel dimensions. Quirky babbling bursts full of static warps, dramatic pauses, then dreamy yet hard-hitting harmonic answers behind the main singer. Psychedelic Frenchcore festival energy, strange beautiful chaos, futuristic glitchy personality. Babble bots we sing through instruments for our voices!, [Instrumental], [Background Vocals]
